text:
maya g: Quick sync — want to lock a webinar theme and run-of-show for early May. Two high-level audiences: engineering teams (perf/cost/ops) and product/PM (ROI, case studies). Thoughts on which we push and who wants to speak?

alex r: I vote engineering-focused. Proposed title + one-line abstract: "Practical inference: balancing latency, cost, and reliability at scale" — abstract: short stories + 2 demos (hosted API failover, dedicated capacity economics). Will do benchmarks + recommendations.

sam t: +1 engineering. Draft run-of-show (can tighten):
```
00:00 Maya - welcome + goals (3m)
03:00 Alex - benchmark narrative & recommendations (12m)
15:00 Jordan - live demo: degrade from hosted -> dedicated fallback (10m)
25:00 Panel: tradeoffs & customer Qs (Alex, Jordan, 1 customer) (15m)
40:00 Q&A + CTAs (slides + signup for trial) (10m)
```

jordan p: I can run the live demo but need a fallback pre-recorded clip in case GPU flakiness. For the live run we'll use the internal reproducible dataset (inference/bench/shortprompts). Can someone confirm access + tokens?

emily s: Logistics notes:
- Rehearsals: propose Tues Apr 30 (tech run) + Wed May 1 (dress), both 30-45m. Please confirm availability.
- Need speaker bios (100 words) + slides by Fri Apr 26.
- Marketing ops: set up registration form, gating, and lead routing to HubSpot with tag `webinar-infer-may` and source=marketing_webinar. Also we should set email drip: reminder -2 days, +1 hour.

maya g: @emily s good call. @alex r @jordan p can you drop bios in the shared drive by EOD Friday? We'll add a short customer case (ask CS) and a customer placeholder for the panel.

calendar-bot: calendar invite created: https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123 (rehearsal invites pending)

sam t: Audience level question — do we make the benchmarks deep (kernel/quant details) or keep to config & ops knobs? My recommendation: show 1 deep slide (quantization/throughput) and keep rest practical.

alex r: Agree with Sam. Also tweak the abstract to call out hosted vs dedicated vs private choices as the CTA — helps customers pick deployment.

jordan p: Will prepare pre-recorded fallback clip and a light troubleshooting checklist. Also: note GPU pool for demo is Ampere A10x, sample command to reproduce below: `./run_demo --model redwood-7b --seq 512 --batch 8`

emily s: Great — locking rehearsals: Tue Apr 30 15:00 PT, Wed May 1 10:00 PT. If you can't make either ping me. I'll create the HubSpot form and confirm lead field mappings.

maya g: Thanks all — sounds like a plan. I'll own run-of-show finalization once bios + slides are in. :raised_hands:
